newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Shenzhen executes 18 for violent crimes.
newsitem.headline: China's Shenzhen executes 18 for violent crimes.

text.p: Eighteen people were executed in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen immediately after a mass rally at which their sentences were announced, the Shenzhen Special Zone Daily said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said the Longgang District People's Court sentenced the 18 on Monday for crimes including murder, rape, robbery and burglary.
Those executed included Wang Fengping, who stole 140,000 yuan ($16,870) worth of telecommunications cables in 1994 when he was a temporary worker for a Shenzhen-based telephone company.
Shenzhen lies just across the border with Hong Kong.
